key: History and literature have an awful habit of letting little girls wander past the forest's edge,
en: History and literature have an awful habit of letting little girls wander past the forest's edge,
ja: 歴史も　文学も　幼い少女を　森の境界の　向こうへ　迷い込ませてしまう　いやな癖が　ある。

key: Only to be swallowed up by any number of enchantments beyond.
en: Only to be swallowed up by any number of enchantments beyond.
ja: その先に　待つ　数え切れぬ魔法に　のみこまれるために。

key: Between wolves, witches, and rabbit holes,
en: Between wolves, witches, and rabbit holes,
ja: オオカミ　魔女　ウサギの穴――

key: The world conceals a plethora of dangers waiting to leap upon and ensnare the unsuspecting and unshakably innocent children.
en: The world conceals a plethora of dangers waiting to leap upon and ensnare the unsuspecting and unshakably innocent children.
ja: 世界は　無防備で　どこまでも　純真な子どもたちに　飛びかかり　捕らえようと　待ち構える　無数の危険を　隠している。

key: LIN: Welcome, \PN.
en: LIN: Welcome, \PN.
ja: リン: ようこそ\PN。

key: You were quite generous to show that boy here.
en: You were quite generous to show that boy here.
ja: あの少年を　ここへ　案内してくれるとは　ずいぶん　親切なことですね。

key: I thank you for that,
en: I thank you for that,
ja: そのことについては　感謝していますよ。

key: Since he, in turn, showed me.
en: Since he, in turn, showed me.
ja: 彼が　結局　私に　教えてくれましたから。

key: He is beyond incompetent, but his victim act must be quite compelling.
en: He is beyond incompetent, but his victim act must be quite compelling.
ja: 彼は　救いようのないほど　無能ですが　被害者を　演じる腕前は　なかなかのものです。

key: Everyone is so quick to give into crocodile tears,
en: Everyone is so quick to give into crocodile tears,
ja: 誰もが　いとも簡単に　うそ泣きに　きずなされるものですが

key: But when they come to the jaws of the beast, they act surprised.
en: But when they come to the jaws of the beast, they act surprised.
ja: 獣の牙が　迫ると　途端に　驚いたふりを　するのですから。

key: How funny.
en: How funny.
ja: 滑稽なことですね。

key: Now, let's get started.
en: Now, let's get started.
ja: さあ　始めましょうか。

key: Better keep your guard up.
en: Better keep your guard up.
ja: 油断なさらないことです。

key: I think we'll be seeing each other a lot more from now on.
en: I think we'll be seeing each other a lot more from now on.
ja: これから　もっと　顔を　合わせることに　なるでしょうね。

key: After all, we have the same goal.
en: After all, we have the same goal.
ja: 私たちは　同じ目的を　持っているのですから。

key: All we have to do is get it from her.
en: All we have to do is get it from her.
ja: あとは　彼女から　それを　手に入れるだけです。

key: Candy from a baby.
en: Candy from a baby.
ja: 赤ん坊から　キャンディを　奪うようなもの。

key: Flowers from a grave.
en: Flowers from a grave.
ja: 墓から　花を　奪うようなもの。

key: I'll be counting on you.
en: I'll be counting on you.
ja: 頼りに　してるわね。

key: Locked.
en: Locked.
ja: 鍵が　かかっている。

key: A faint light can be seen at the bottom.
en: A faint light can be seen at the bottom.
ja: 底の方に　かすかな光が　見える。

key: Jump?
en: Jump?
ja: 飛び降りますか?

key: Why not?
en: Why not?
ja: いいでしょう?

key: LIN: Didn't I tell you to keep your guard up?
en: LIN: Didn't I tell you to keep your guard up?
ja: リン: 油断しないようにって　言ったはずですけど?

key: LIN: Night-night, knight light.
en: LIN: Night-night, knight light.
ja: リン: おやすみなさい　騎士さん。

key: ADRIENN: Hello, \PN!
en: ADRIENN: Hello, \PN!
ja: アドリエンヌ: こんにちは\PN!

key: So you made it to Titania's Gym. That's a relief.
en: So you made it to Titania's Gym. That's a relief.
ja: ティタニアのジムまで　たどり着いたのね。ほっとしたわ。

key: I read over the notes for her earlier. She has a sort of makeshift world out there, right?
en: I read over the notes for her earlier. She has a sort of makeshift world out there, right?
ja: 前に　彼女についての資料に　目を　通したの。あそこには　彼女なりの　間に合わせの世界が　あるのよね?

key: I'm sure it's just constructed according to her story, but it sounds beautiful nonetheless.
en: I'm sure it's just constructed according to her story, but it sounds beautiful nonetheless.
ja: きっと　彼女の物語に　沿って　作られてるだけなんでしょうけど　それでも　美しい話に　聞こえるわ。

key: I'd like to see it myself some time, but for now, let's go over her battling style.
en: I'd like to see it myself some time, but for now, let's go over her battling style.
ja: いつか　わたしも　この目で　見てみたいけど　今は　彼女のバトルスタイルを　確認しましょう。

key: I think you already know that she relies greatly on her Aegislash.
en: I think you already know that she relies greatly on her Aegislash.
ja: もう　知ってると思うけど　彼女は　ギルガルドに　大きく頼ってるわ。

key: In her Fairy Tale Field, the Stance Change Ability will be even stronger than it usually is.
en: In her Fairy Tale Field, the Stance Change Ability will be even stronger than it usually is.
ja: 彼女の　おとぎ話フィールドでは　バトルスイッチの　特性が　普段より　さらに　強くなるの。

key: Her team takes a similar approach, shifting a defensive front into an offensive one.
en: Her team takes a similar approach, shifting a defensive front into an offensive one.
ja: 彼女のチーム全体も　似た戦い方で　守りの構えから　攻めへと　切り替えてくるわ。

key: Your chances will be best if you can pre-empt her set up, but her type's natural bulk will make that difficult.
en: Your chances will be best if you can pre-empt her set up, but her type's natural bulk will make that difficult.
ja: 彼女の準備を　先手で　崩せれば　勝機は　高くなるけど　タイプ相性上の　もともとの耐久力が　それを　難しくしてる。

key: Alternatively, you might fare better by trying to meet her offense head to head with your own.
en: Alternatively, you might fare better by trying to meet her offense head to head with your own.
ja: それか　あなた自身の攻撃で　正面から　ぶつかっていく方が　うまくいくかも　しれないわ。

key: I'm sure you'll be able to figure something out.
en: I'm sure you'll be able to figure something out.
ja: きっと　何か　いい方法を　見つけられるはずよ。

key: After all, you're the future Champion of Reborn!
en: After all, you're the future Champion of Reborn!
ja: だって　あなたは　未来の　リボーンチャンピオンなんだから!

key: I gotta run now. Best of luck, \PN!
en: I gotta run now. Best of luck, \PN!
ja: わたし　もう　行かなきゃ。頑張ってね\PN!

key: No one seems to be picking up at the Grand Hall...
en: No one seems to be picking up at the Grand Hall...
ja: グランドホールでは　誰も　電話に　出ないようだ……

key: Yes
en: Yes
ja: はい

key: No
en: No
ja: いいえ
